company.name: Liv Labs
company.shortDescription: Pelvic floor fitness made easy and affordable
company.description: Liv Labs makes convenient self-care products and services to improve pelvic floor fitness. Our flagship product is a silicone resistance spring worn internally (by women) to activate pelvic floors muscles during exercise. Our larger mission is to put people in expert control of their own fitness and physical wellbeing. We seek to serve people from all walks of life, around the globe.

productsAndServices.description: An internally worn, soft silicone resistance spring used during exercise to support pelvic floor muscle engagement and coordination without batteries or a separate workout routine.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $563,008, or 17.38% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 4 disclosed grants total $2,542,073, representing 78.47% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,215,881 to $6,215,881, a 1x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 51 (-10 over 90 days) and market heat at 67 (-9).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.
